description: This file defines the AppTheme class that provides a customized ThemeData configuration for a Flutter application. It sets global visual styles, such as colors, elevations, and component themes, utilizing Material 3 design principles.

classes.name: AppTheme
classes.description: Provides static methods to generate ThemeData for light and dark themes in a Flutter app, encapsulating styling preferences such as colors, elevations, shapes, and component-specific themes.

methods.name: light
methods.description: Returns the light ThemeData configuration with Material 3 enabled, custom color scheme, component themes, and system UI overlay style settings.

methods.name: _colorScheme
methods.description: Generates a ColorScheme object defining primary, secondary, error, background, surface, and other color properties used by the theme.
